newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU has contacted Boeing, McDonnell - Van Miert.
newsitem.headline: EU has contacted Boeing, McDonnell - Van Miert.

text.p: The European Commission has had contacts with Boeing and McDonnell Douglas over the planemakers' planned merger and expects to receive a formal notification of the deal within weeks, European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert said on Wednesday.
"There have been contacts with the parties concerned," Van Miert told a European Parliament committee. "This is a case with which the Commission has to deal."
Van Miert repeated the Commission's position that granting European Union clearance to the merger under competition rules could be difficult.
"This is a difficult case. Boeing has 60 percent of the commercial airline (market). While McDonnell's market share is going down, it still adds to Boeing's," he said.
In December, Van Miert warned both companies that their planned $13.3 billion merger could hurt competition in Europe.
He has said the Commission would have to examine the deal closely to assess whether it would strengthen the hold of the merged companies over any product or market in the European Union.
On Wednesday, he said this could be a long process.
"This will take some time. It is complicated," he said.
